verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a prompt cache. Cached input tokens are billed at a discount, by default 50% of the input price on text and vision models. An x-session-affinity sticky-routing header pins repeated requests to the same replica to maximize cache hit rate, which together cover the cost side and give the engineer an explicit lever. Missing for 10: documentation of latency gains from cache hits, cache mechanics (TTL, minimum prefix length, behavior on dedicated deployments), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
